name: lastfm
title: Last.fm
description: Your recent, loved and top music from Last.fm.
author: black

commands.name: recent
commands.title: Recent Tracks
commands.description: What you played last, newest first

commands.name: loved
commands.title: Loved Tracks
commands.description: Tracks you have loved on Last.fm

commands.name: artists
commands.title: Top Artists
commands.description: Your most played artists for a period

commands.name: albums
commands.title: Top Albums
commands.description: Your most played albums for a period

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse Last.fm
commands.description: Global charts, this week, your top tracks, your library, and any artist

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: From https://www.last.fm/api/accounts/create. Leave the callback URL empty: this extension never receives a redirect, and needs no shared secret.

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Last.fm Username
preferences.description: The handle on your profile page, not your display name.

preferences.name: period
preferences.title: Period
preferences.description: Which window Top Artists and Top Albums count. Recent and Loved are always all time.
